title: Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis: Zero-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation and Non-Linear Decision Boundaries
description: This open-science research package presents the complete theoretical framework, empirical replication pipeline, and interactive simulation laboratories for Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis. Deriving synaptic weights and activation biases procedurally from Mandelbrot fractal dynamics (z = z^2 + c) via 4-Quadrant Partitioning eliminates static weight tensor arrays. A functional decision cell is instantiated from only 24 bytes of coordinate metadata (three Float64 values: cx, cy, zoom), exhibiting constant O(1) storage complexity regardless of projection dimensionality. Evaluated across repeated trials (K=10 independent random seeds), procedural networks achieve 100% classification accuracy on linearly separable boolean gates and XOR, 99.30% +/- 0.18% on Two-Moons (N=1000), and 98.50% +/- 0.32% on Two-Spirals (N=200). The package includes camera-ready author preprints, replication scripts, offline interactive HTML5 laboratories, and extended bilingual documentation.
notes: Version 3.0: Comprehensive Empirical Validation, 10/10 Seed Multi-Run Benchmarks, Generative AI Declaration, and Author Affiliation Harmonization.
